constitutional.constitution of india: Supreme law of India, adopted in 1950, foundational to all other laws.
constitutional.article 1: Name and territory of the Union: India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States.
constitutional.article 21: Protection of life and personal liberty: No person shall be deprived of his life except according to procedure established by law.
constitutional.government of india act 1935: A key precursor to the Constitution, providing the federal structure.

criminal.ipc 302: Punishment for murder: Death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
criminal.crpc 154: Information in cognizable cases; the basis for filing an FIR.
criminal.bns 4: General explanations and definitions under the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
criminal.arms act 3: Prohibits acquisition or possession of firearms without a license.

civil_property.cpc 9: Courts shall have jurisdiction to try all suits of a civil nature.
civil_property.transfer of property 5: Defines 'Transfer of Property' as an act by which a living person conveys property.
civil_property.easements act 4: Defines an easement as a right which the owner of land possesses.

family.hindu adoption 7: Capacity of a male Hindu to take in adoption.
family.muslim marriage act 2: Grounds for decree for dissolution of Muslim marriage.

labor.minimum wages act 3: Fixing of minimum rates of wages by the appropriate government.
